text: ポケモンしょうぶで　にげだそうと　するとは　なにごとじゃ！

structure.jp: にげだそうと　するとは
structure.en: to think you'd try to run away
what is the meaning of this!

patterns.name: 〜ようとする
patterns.span: にげだそうと　する
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in おう or よう plus とする says someone is trying to do it or is about to. にげだそうと する = 'try to run away'.

patterns.name: 〜とは (surprise)
patterns.explanation: とは after a verb shows shock at what was just said, like 'to think that...!'. にげだそうと するとは = 'to think you'd try to run away!'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'it is'. なにごとじゃ = 'what is this!'.
